faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Environmental Control Duct suitable for ECS ducting for cabin pressurization?
faq.a: Titanium Environmental Control Duct uses Grade 9 Ti-3Al-2.5V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address pneumatic system operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Environmental Control Duct?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Environmental Control Duct is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for ecs ducting for requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Environmental Control Duct require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. ecs ducting for components require Shot peening Almen 0.008-0.012A inducing compressive residual stress for extended HCF life in aerospace service — tailored for ecs ducting for application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Environmental Control Duct shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Environmental Control Duct includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet ecs ducting for specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.
